construct: the SAME coincident inset ring as pseudo-inset-ring-two-axis, but the ring pseudo EXISTS IN ONLY HALF THE DOMAIN (`[data-size="small"]::after`) while the host carries an opaque per-combo border-colour and zero border width of its own in ALL eight combos
why: THE ANTI-HARM GUARD for the coincident-ring fold. Folding the ring's uniform 1px onto the host is only honest when the ring is a ring in EVERY combo: if the box is absent at size=large, the host's already-carried opaque border-{side}-colour would complete the pair there too and the canvas would manufacture a 1px stroke where CSS paints nothing — the HARMFUL class, not a silent loss, and exactly the failure hasWidthSource's own guard exists to prevent. The fold must refuse by a name that DISCLOSES the partial presence (drawn/present N of M), because the paint-multiaxis refusal beside it says 'in all drawn combos' and never admits how many combos have no ring at all.

canvas.note: nothing may carry the ring's width: a fold here would paint a stroke on the four size=large cells the library leaves bare
